question.text: The alkali metals form salt-like hydrides by the direct synthesis at elevated temperature. The thermal stability of these hydrides decreases in which of the following orders?

solution.text: The stability of alkali metal hydrides decreases from Li to Cs. It is due to the fact that $\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{H}$ bonds becomes weaker with increase in size of alkali metals as we move down the group from $\mathrm{Li}$ to $\mathrm{Cs}$. Thus the order of stability of hydrides is $\mathrm{LiH}>\mathrm{NaH}>\mathrm{KH}>\mathrm{RbH}>\mathrm{CsH}$
